broker.tagline: On its own site since 2001. Its site names 7 regulators, including FCA, SCB, and BCB. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Varies by symbol and position size.
broker.about: ActivTrades says it has operated since 2001. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include ActivTrader, MetaTrader 4, and MetaTrader 5. Platforms named there include ActivTrader, MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, and TradingView. The site names these regulators: FCA, SCB, BCB, CVM, CMVM, FSC (Mauritius), and CMA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Varies by symbol and position size. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FCA. SCB. BCB: ActivTrades CCTVM. CVM: ActivTrades CCTVM. CMVM. FSC (Mauritius). CMA.

leverage.value: Varies by symbol and position size
leverage.note: The leverage page says the displayed data is for Mauritius clients. Visible stock rows included ratios such as 1:10, 1:20, 1:40, 1:50, 1:60 and 1:75. It does not state one firm-wide maximum. Hedged positions require 10% margin. MT4 and MT5 default total exposure up to 20 million. Individual stock and ETF exposure limited to 500,000 USD.

broker.leverage_summary: Varies by symbol and position size
broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: The individual account page and the platform comparison did not state one minimum deposit. A news article snippet said 10 USD and a YouTrading campaign snippet said no minimum deposit. Those two pages were not fetched in full, and they conflict, so no number is recorded.

_notes.fetch_notes: Fetched on 2026-10-11. Why-us says licensed in five countries (UK, Portugal, Brazil, Mauritius and the Bahamas) and also names the UAE CMA, so the count and the list do not match. No licence numbers or company registration number were on the fetched pages. Why-us says a pioneer since 2001 and the homepage says since 2001. Retail funds insurance up to 1,000,000 USD and negative balance protection for retail clients are stated. Homepage retail CFD loss rate was 84%. A TradingView campaign URL in search also named CSSF; that page was not fetched, so CSSF is not listed. Street address was not on the pages fetched.
